description: This is a Kotlin class defining a Fragment for a catalog UI in an Android shopping application. It manages product listing, filtering, sorting, recent searches, and navigation to product details and cart.

classes.name: CatalogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment representing a product catalog with filtering, sorting, recent searches, and navigation capabilities.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components, restores preferences, sets up event listeners, and renders category filters and recent searches.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Cleans up pending runnables to prevent memory leaks after the view is destroyed.

methods.name: setupFavoritesOnlyToggle
methods.description: Configures the toggle button for showing only favorite products.

methods.name: updateFavoritesOnlyButton
methods.description: Updates the UI state of the favorites-only toggle button.

methods.name: setupDebouncedSearch
methods.description: Sets up a debounced listener on the search input to trigger filtering after user pauses typing.

methods.name: setupSortDropdown
methods.description: Initializes the sorting options spinner and its selection logic.

methods.name: renderCategoryFilters
methods.description: Creates category filter chips dynamically based on available categories.

methods.name: refreshProducts
methods.description: Applies filters and sorting, then updates the product list UI accordingly.

methods.name: sortOptionToSpinnerPosition
methods.description: Converts a sorting option enum to spinner position index.

methods.name: sortKeyToSortOption
methods.description: Converts a sort key string to a SortOption enum.

methods.name: persistCatalogPreferences
methods.description: Saves current filter and sort states to persistent storage.

methods.name: restoreCatalogPreferences
methods.description: Loads persisted filter and sort states and applies them to UI components.

methods.name: applyFilters
methods.description: Filters the list of products based on selected category, search query, and favorites filter.

methods.name: applySorting
methods.description: Sorts the filtered product list based on the selected sort option.

methods.name: matchesSearch
methods.description: Checks if a product matches the current search query based on product name or category.

methods.name: relevanceScore
methods.description: Computes a heuristic relevance score for sorting products by relevance to the search query.

methods.name: setupRecentSearchesUi
methods.description: Initializes the recent searches clear button.

methods.name: renderRecentSearches
methods.description: Displays recent search queries as clickable chips for quick re-search.

methods.name: applyRecentSearch
methods.description: Sets the search input to a recent query and triggers search filtering.

methods.name: dpToPx
methods.description: Converts density-independent pixels to physical pixels.
